text:
Time Time.

Noon stalled among damp chills.

The bored barracks pump bails out

time time time time.


Was Was.


Roosters song while scratching in vain.

Mouth of clear day conjugating

was was was was.


Tomorrow Tomorrow.


Rest still warm from being.

The present thinks keep me for

tomorrow tomorrow tomorrow tomorrow.


Name Name.


What is the name of all that bristles us?

Its name is Thesame that suffers

name name name namE.

translation.title: Trilce: Poem II — Time Time
translation.editorial_note: Cantic verbal mutation and capitalization reproduce Vallejo's pressure on tense, naming, and sameness rather than smoothing grammar.
